shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a flat panel
stylised plant forms (in B, small flowers along the ground line)
justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of stylised multi-petalled flower/rosette heads on stalks, which fill the whole of A but appear only as tiny ground-line fillers in B. Otherwise A is an entirely vegetal, repeating vertical panel with no figures, while B is a figural procession of profile human attendants leading horned rams, so subject, relationships and arrangement have essentially nothing in common.
